svg.title: Plug length
svg.desc: Two top views of one plate of the two-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults, a 20 mm wide plug in teal. Right: plug length at 40 mm: lengthens both arms so the teeth cover the whole plug body, and moves the zip-tie stations and the strap slot with them. Marked in red: 1, the arms: the two toothed arms in the upper half. The plate edge, the teeth, the finger lobes and the cord channel stay where they were.
